items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I thought Leon and Otis Renee wrote that, but they wrote Sleepy Time Down Inside.

ctx.x: I thought Leon and Otis Renee wrote that. Huh?

I thought Leon and Otis Renee wrote that, but they wrote Sleepy Time Down Inside. Yeah, this is a good song, isn't it? Yeah. What about, uh... Where the sun sets in the sky and the day, and flowers never- Die, friend, don't pass you by. That's my home. And they all says, how do you do? And I know doggone well they mean it too, boy. Well, old mammy love is true. That's my home. And it don't matter how I roam. I'm always welcome back. Though to you it may look like an old shack. But to me, to me, to me, that's…
